findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "mcw-signals-market-data" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "mcw-signals-market-data" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mcw-get-story, mcw-signals-market-data · Public sink: mcw-signals-thesis · Destructive: mcw-signals-charts, mcw-signals-meta, mcw-signals-sentiment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mcw-get-story, mcw-signals-market-data · Public sink: mcw-signals-thesis · Destructive: mcw-signals-charts, mcw-signals-meta, mcw-signals-sentiment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
